statement: For any fixed s>=3, R(s,k) >> k^{s-1}/(log k)^c for some constant c=c(s)>0.
conjecture_origin: First conjectured by Erdos in 1947 (per Chung & Graham [ChGr98]).
weak_problem_status: RESOLVED for all s>=3 by Brada? [Br26] (arXiv:2605.28793), which gives c=2s-4. Spencer [Sp77] had s=3; Mattheus-Verstraete [MaVe23] had s=4.

best_general_bounds_s_ge_5.upper: (1+o(1)) k^{s-1}/(log k)^{s-2}  (Ajtai-Komlos-Szemeredi [AKS80], sharp constant (1+o(1)) by Li-Rousseau-Zang [LRZ01])

openai_note_verbatim: An earlier version of Brada? work had an exponent of s-2 - the adjustment to achieve s-1 was observed by an internal model at OpenAI.
interpretation: Problem #986 as STATED (exists c>0) is resolved by Brada?. The SHARP question - best possible c, i.e. c=s-2+o(1) matching the AKS/LRZ upper - is the live frontier (the 2s-4 vs s-2 polylog gap). This card pins that sharp gap.
